scale.expression: local s=0; if time>=45.50 and time<135.50 then s=45.50 end; if time>=172.50 and time<262.50 then s=172.50 end; if (time>=45.50 and time<135.50) or (time>=172.50 and time<262.50) then local b=math.abs(math.sin(math.pi*(time-s)/0.6)); return Vec.v2(value.x*(1+0.04*(1-b)), value.y*(1-0.04*(1-b))) else return value end

position.expression: local s=0; if time>=45.50 and time<135.50 then s=45.50 end; if time>=172.50 and time<262.50 then s=172.50 end; if (time>=45.50 and time<135.50) or (time>=172.50 and time<262.50) then local b=math.abs(math.sin(math.pi*(time-s)/0.6)); return value+Vec.v2(0,-45*b) else return value+Vec.v2(0,-10*math.sin(2*math.pi*time/1.6)) end

content.text:
Brush Your Teeth
with Mokki!
Let's sing!
Now YOU sing with Mokki!
Wake up, wake up, the sun says hi!
Mokki stretches to the sky!
Grab your brush and toothpaste too,
Tiny pea, just like I do!
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Top and bottom, up and down!
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Round and round and round and round!
Little circles, front and back,
Bye-bye, bye-bye, sugar snack!
Count with Mokki: one, two, three,
Shiny teeth for you and me!
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Top and bottom, up and down!
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Round and round and round and round!
Swish and spit, and smile so bright,
Morning teeth and teeth at night!
Ding! Sparkle!

Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Round and round and round and round!
Swish and spit, and smile so bright,
Morning teeth and teeth at night!
Ding! Sparkle!

1. A tiny bit of toothpaste,
as small as a pea!
2. Brush up and down!
3. Little circles, round and round!

4. Brush 2 times a day:
morning and night!
Get your toothbrush!

Bye-bye, friends!
See you tomorrow!
